name: (04) Abombwe — 2 Intermediate — Whistling Up the Beast

system.description: You whistle, sing or hum atonally for a full turn, then enter a Social Challenge with your target (who must have a notable Beast, as per Predator's Communion). If you succeed, your target must retreat cautiously from you, or enter Rötschreck if unable to retreat. If you lose, the target is one Trait down on all challenges against you for the rest of the scene, as well as on frenzy or Rötschreck tests. You can also use this power to voluntarily enter frenzy after one turn of singing or humming.
